purpose: Before-image of fields changed by the holiday event-link repair; all posts were already published. Unchanged item fields remain in Supabase.

items.name: Disney Springs
items.why: The Christmas Tree Stroll winds past extravagantly decorated trees, including Disney, Pixar and Star Wars inspired designs and a returning Toy Story inspired tree. Snow falls nightly in Town Center, and local bands play on select nights at the AdventHealth Waterside Stage.
items.best_time: Holiday season Nov 13, 2026 to Jan 6, 2027.

items.name: Magic Kingdom Park
items.why: Holiday trimmings line Main Street, U.S.A. and the park, with photo spots at Cinderella Castle and Space Mountain. In Frozen Holiday Surprise, Olaf and his snow siblings decorate the castle and Elsa turns it into a glowing ice palace.
items.best_time: Nov 13, 2026 to Jan 6, 2027, during park hours.

items.name: Epcot
items.why: The EPCOT International Festival of the Holidays returns Nov 27 to Dec 30, 2026 with holiday storytellers at the pavilions, Holiday Kitchens food booths and a gingerbread Spaceship Earth. The Candlelight Processional also begins Nov 27 at the America Gardens Theatre.
items.best_time: Nov 27 to Dec 30, 2026, during park hours.

items.name: SeaWorld Orlando
items.why: SeaWorld's Christmas Celebration includes Sea of Trees, Winter Wonderland on Ice and Holiday Reflections, a fireworks show viewable around the lagoon at park close. The park also lists Santa meet and greets and Rudolph and Bumble at Rudolph's Christmas town.
items.best_time: Select dates Nov 6, 2026 to Jan 4, 2027, per the park hours calendar.

items.name: Busch Gardens Tampa Bay
items.why: Christmas Town at Busch Gardens fills the park with what the park describes as nearly 70 miles of glittering lights. Shows include Lights of Wonder and A Very Merry Cirque!, and you can visit Santa's Workshop and ride the Holly Jolly Express train.
items.best_time: Select dates from November 13, 2026 through January 4, 2027. The tree lighting ceremony is November 13, with the lighting at 7 PM.

items.name: ZooTampa at Lowry Park
items.why: Christmas in the Wild at ZooTampa adds light displays, holiday music, family shows and a chance to get your picture with Santa. The zoo also lists winter themed animal experiences and seasonal food and drinks.
items.best_time: Select nights from November 27 to December 30, 2026. Admission is after 4 PM, and November 27 is a member preview night.

items.name: Tropicana Field
items.why: Enchant Christmas St. Petersburg is set up at Tropicana Field with a light maze, a shopping village with photo moments, Santa visits, live entertainment and caroling. Ice skating is sold as an add on.
items.best_time: Nov 20 through Dec 27, 2026. Theme nights include Country Christmas on December 4 and Paws and Claus on December 6.

items.name: Gatorland
items.why: The Holiday Ho, Ho, Ho-Down features photos with Gator Claus in a sleigh built for the swamp and a meet with the Krampus Croc. The park also lists holiday music, decorations, interactive characters, arts and crafts vendors and cryptid carols from the Florida Skunk Ape.
items.best_time: Dec 5, 6, 12, 13, 19 and 20, 2026. Dates are subject to change.

items.name: SeaWorld Orlando
items.why: SeaWorld's Christmas Celebration lists Santa meet and greets at the Waterway Grill and Rudolph and Bumble at Rudolph's Christmas town on the Pipeline Pathway. The Sesame Street Christmas Parade takes place in Sesame Street Land, and Winter Wonderland on Ice runs on select dates.
items.best_time: Select dates Nov 6, 2026 to Jan 4, 2027.

items.name: Busch Gardens Tampa Bay
items.why: Christmas Town at Busch Gardens includes Santa's Workshop with photo ops, meet and greets with Rudolph and Friends, and the Holly Jolly Express train. The park's theme park rides and attractions also run, along with nearly 70 miles of lights.
items.best_time: Select dates from November 13, 2026 through January 4, 2027.

items.name: ZooTampa at Lowry Park
items.why: The zoo describes light displays, holiday music, a chance to get your picture with Santa and family shows. It also lists winter themed Wildlife Connections and Signature Animal Encounters.
items.best_time: Select nights from November 27 to December 30, 2026, with admission after 4 PM.

items.name: Tropicana Field
items.why: Enchant Christmas St. Petersburg includes a light maze, a shopping village with photo moments, live entertainment and caroling, and a chance to visit Santa. Theme nights such as Paws and Claus on December 6 are included with admission.
items.best_time: November 20 through December 27, 2026.

items.name: MOSI
items.why: MOSI's Santa in Space includes festive planetarium shows, letter writing to send to the North Pole, shopping at the Merry Market, seasonal treats and science experiments. Santa photos are in Mission: Moonbase.
items.best_time: Saturday, December 12, 2026. Activities 10 AM to 4 PM, Santa photos 2 to 6 PM.

items.name: Epcot
items.why: The Candlelight Processional at the America Gardens Theatre tells the Christmas story with a celebrity narrator, a choir of more than 150 voices and a 50 piece orchestra. It is part of EPCOT International Festival of the Holidays.
items.best_time: Nov 27 to Dec 30, 2026, nightly with multiple showtimes.

items.name: Disney's Hollywood Studios
items.why: Disney Jollywood Nights is a separately ticketed Christmas party at Disney's Hollywood Studios with entertainment, limited time experiences and character encounters. Disney describes it as a glamorous old Hollywood party.
items.best_time: Select nights Nov 7, 14, 16, 21, 23 and 28; Dec 5, 7, 12, 14, 19, 21 and 23; Jan 3 and 5. Entry from 5:30 PM, festivities 7:30 PM to 12:30 AM.

items.name: Tropicana Field
items.why: Enchant Christmas St. Petersburg pairs a light maze with a shopping village, live entertainment, caroling and a light up dance floor. The organizer lists Friends Night Out and theme nights such as Country Christmas on December 4.
items.best_time: November 20 through December 27, 2026.

items.name: Busch Gardens Tampa Bay
items.why: Busch Gardens lists New Year's Eve inside its Christmas Town season, with daytime fun and a fireworks finale that night. Christmas Town includes Lights of Wonder, A Very Merry Cirque! and Rudolph and Friends.
items.best_time: Thursday, December 31, 2026.

items.name: Epcot
items.why: The EPCOT International Festival of the Holidays runs Nov 27 to Dec 30, 2026, with holiday storytellers, festival food booths and a gingerbread Spaceship Earth. The Candlelight Processional begins Nov 27 at the America Gardens Theatre.
items.best_time: Opens Friday, Nov 27, 2026, during park hours.

items.name: Magic Kingdom Park
items.why: Mickey's Very Merry Christmas Party runs on select nights through Dec 22, and Nov 27 and Nov 29 are both party nights. The party starts at 7 PM and ticket holders may enter from 4 PM.
items.best_time: Friday, Nov 27 and Sunday, Nov 29, 2026. Party at 7 PM.

items.name: Disney's Hollywood Studios
items.why: Jollywood Nights is a separately ticketed Christmas party at Disney's Hollywood Studios with entertainment, limited time experiences and character encounters. Nov 28 is one of the select nights.
items.best_time: Saturday, Nov 28, 2026. Entry from 5:30 PM, festivities 7:30 PM to 12:30 AM.

items.name: SeaWorld Orlando
items.why: SeaWorld's Christmas Celebration includes Sea of Trees, Winter Wonderland on Ice, Santa meet and greets and the Sesame Street Christmas Parade. Holiday Reflections fireworks are viewable around the lagoon at park close.
items.best_time: Select dates from Nov 6, 2026. Nov 20 through 29 are listed event dates.

items.name: ZooTampa at Lowry Park
items.why: ZooTampa's event calendar says it is closed on Thanksgiving. Christmas in the Wild starts with a Member Preview Night on Friday, November 27 from 4 to 10 PM, and a Saturday, November 28 listing runs 4 to 10 PM.
items.best_time: Closed November 26. Member Preview Night November 27, 2026.

items.name: Tropicana Field
items.why: Enchant Christmas St. Petersburg runs at Tropicana Field with a light maze, Santa visits, a village and live entertainment. The organizer lists Friendsgiving among its theme nights, with dates on its theme night calendar.
items.best_time: November 20 through December 27, 2026.
